entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this piece of junk VeloBand I bought. It's completely useless and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the product. To pull up your order, could I get your full name and order number, please?
It's Mike Schmidt. Order number 774-B2-910. I expect a full refund, no questions asked.

Thank you, Mike. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered eight days ago. To make sure I'm documenting this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
The issue is that I hate it! It's uncomfortable and I don't want it. That's the issue. Are you going to process my return or do I need to talk to your manager? This is wasting my time.

I understand completely, and there's no need to speak with a manager. I can handle this for you. I just needed to confirm the reason for our records. Let me quickly review the return eligibility for your order.
Okay, I've checked our policy. Since the item was delivered just eight days ago, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that for you.
So you're actually going to do it? No restocking fees or other nonsense?

No, sir. It will be a full refund. I have just initiated the return process in our system. I am sending a pre-paid return shipping label to the email we have on file. You just need to package the sensor back in its original box, apply the label, and drop it at a post office.
Once our warehouse scans the return, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment within 3-5 business days. You'll get an email notification as soon as it's processed.
Fine. About time. Make sure that email comes through.
It has just been sent. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Mike. Have a good rest of your day.
